Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
800 AM EDT Sun Sep 13 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Central Subtropical Atlantic:
Disorganized showers and thunderstorms continue in association 
with a trough of low pressure over the central Subtropical Atlantic. 
While the environmental conditions are not currently favorable for 
development due to strong upper-level winds, the system is expected 
to move into a more favorable environment for some gradual 
development by the middle to later portion of this week. The 
disturbance is forecast to move west-northwestward across the 
central part of the Subtropical Atlantic.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

$$
Forecaster Katz/Brown
